theater: 大周防・三山(現山口縣柳井市)

battle.name: 天狗黨之亂
battle.theater: 大周防・三山(現山口縣柳井市)
battle.brief: 一八六四年三月,長州藩浪人高杉晉作率三十餘名天狗黨徒眾在萩起事,轉入大周防山區,靠鄉士接應游擊藩兵,終在柳井三山被長州藩軍包圍殲滅。事件成為幕府第一次征討長州的藉口。卡面加特林機槍一八六〇年方問世,天狗黨實際持用的仍是火繩銃,新舊兩代兵器的落差正是此役關鍵。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 這場衝突有三方捲入,並非國家之間的戰爭。幕府一方是德川家慶治下的中央幕府,由總裁德川慶喜主持,尊王派各藩之中尾張藩與紀州藩出動藩兵,豐前藩與幕府直轄的番頭、侍鐵砲隊亦隨軍,朝廷在孝明天皇之下表面上與幕府同一陣線。長州藩一方是藩主毛利敬親的毛利氏藩,以萩城為後方,藩兵與藩士配備洋銃與大砲,而江戶留居的長州藩過激派數百人一度加入幕府軍作戰,與同藩正兵各走各路。天狗黨一方沒有國家與旗號,主體是長州藩脫籍浪人與受過松下村塾教育的青年士族,起事時僅三十餘人,轉入大周防後吸納當地鄉士、農民與漁民,膨脹到百餘乃至三百人上下,作戰上分小隊游擊而無常設指揮機關。三方的指揮系統互不相同:幕府以三路大軍的合戰與江戶中樞為軸,長州以家老層與萩城守備為骨幹,天狗黨則靠高杉晉作等首領的個人號令與鄉士嚮導運作,這也是三者之間始終無法建立統一戰線的根本原因。
countriesEn: The conflict drew three parties into it and was not a war between sovereign states. On the shogunate side stood the central government of Tokugawa Ieyoshi, conducted under the sosai Tokugawa Yoshinobu; among the domains of the sonno faction, Owari and Kishu sent domain troops, while Buzen and the shogunate's own hatamoto and artillery units marched alongside them, and the imperial court under Emperor Komei stood formally on the shogunate's side. The Choshu side was the Mori clan domain of daimyo Mori Yoshichika, based at Hagi Castle, its soldiers and retainers armed with percussion rifles and artillery, while a few hundred Choshu men of the kagekiha in Edo temporarily fought on the shogunate's side, going their own way apart from the regular domain troops. The Tengu Party had neither state nor flag: its core was a handful of Choshu ronin and young scholars who had been schooled at the Matsushita Village School, only about thirty-odd men at the start, swollen by local goshi, farmers and fishermen once they entered Osuo to somewhere between a hundred and three hundred men; tactically they fought as small bands in guerrilla fashion with no permanent command structure. The three command systems were entirely different: the axis of the shogunate was the convergence of three field armies on the central command in Edo, Choshu's backbone was its council of elders together with the garrison at Hagi, and the Tengu Party ran itself on the personal orders of leaders such as Takasugi Shintaro and on the guidance of local villagers, which is precisely why no united front could ever be formed among the three.
people: 核心人物是天狗黨首領高杉晉作。他一八三九年生於長州萩,少年時入吉田松陰的松下村塾,因變賣亡父遺物換取讀本而被逐出塾門,此後流落江湖數年,據說曾向外國人學習英語;一八六三年冬萩之亂後,他率數十名同志在大周防的深山中集結,以天狗面遮面夜行,自此隊伍得「天狗黨」之名,同行者中還有其兄弟高杉重吉,以及其後在土佐龍潛浦事件中出名的內田良平。幕府與藩方的重要人物則是德川家慶與總裁德川慶喜,以及長州藩主毛利敬親;藩內的益田孝與留守萩城的村田實藏,以談判手腕促成講和,其後益田更成為幕府大老。背景上,一八六三年十二月萩之亂中,先祓的徒眾闖入萩城下町,殺害幕府方的郡司楫取道明與宮長惠美,這兩宗命案是天狗黨事件與第一次征討長州之間最直接的因果鏈。天狗黨自身也有路線之爭:高杉一派主張以騷亂逼幕府全面介入,另一派則仍寄望於藩內尊王派能夠主導大義,兩者在行軍節奏與是否對藩開火上屢有分歧。
peopleEn: The central figure was the leader of the Tengu Party, Takasugi Shintaro. Born in Hagi in the province of Nagato in 1839, he entered the Matsushita Village School of Yoshida Shoin as a boy and was expelled from it after selling off his dead father's belongings to buy reading matter, and he spent several years drifting about the provinces afterwards; he is said to have taken lessons in English from a foreigner. After the disturbance at Hagi in the winter of 1863 he gathered several dozen comrades in the deep hills of Osuo, marched with tengu masks over their faces by night, and from that point the band was known as the Tengu Party; marching with him were his brother Takasugi Shigeyoshi and Uchida Ryohei, who would later become known for the Ryusen'yo affair in Tosa. On the shogunate and domain side the names that matter are Tokugawa Ieyoshi and the sosai Tokugawa Yoshinobu, and Mori Yoshichika, lord of Choshu; within the domain it was Masuda Takashi and Murata Juzo, who held the line at Hagi Castle, whose negotiating skill brought about the peace, and Masuda afterwards became the shogunate's great elder. In the background lie two killings: in December 1863, in the disturbance at Hagi, men of the Senpuku band entered the town below Hagi Castle and murdered the shogunate officials Kaidori Michiaki and Miyanaga Keimi, and these two deaths form the most direct chain of causation between the Tengu Party affair and the First Choshu Expedition. The Tengu Party had its own internal disputes as well: Takasugi's group believed that a disturbance large enough to tie down the shogunate's forces would pin the shogunate's whole attention on Choshu and give the sonno or the anti-shogunate party inside the domain its opening, while another group still placed its hopes on the sonno party within the domain carrying out the great cause; the two differed repeatedly over the pace of the march and over whether to open fire on their own lord.
kits: 卡面這件加特林機槍在一八六四年才剛剛走出試製階段:理查德·喬丹·加特林於一八六〇年完成設計並取得專利,以人力手搖帶動六根槍管迴轉,所有彈藥從中央單一軸線射出,後坐力分散在六次擊發之間,射速遠高於同時代任何一種單管砲;一八六二年起它在美國南北戰爭中少量投入戰場,英法等國其後才開始試購,東亞各國則一律未備。天狗黨實際攜帶的完全是另一個時代的東西:幾乎全是十八世紀以來早已停產的火繩銃,例如日本國友砲一類的舊製品,近戰依靠素槍與刀;其手中是否混有少量由長崎流入的外來槍械,史料說法不一,但可確定的是,黨徒的主武裝仍是停產已久的火繩銃,數量亦有限。與之對照,長州藩兵已換裝洋銃並配備大砲,幕府征討軍更帶有紀州藩的臼砲與大砲。加特林機槍在這場戰役中的位置,恰恰是它所標示的年代轉折:以多管機關砲取代舊砲的時代正在到來,而天狗黨手裡仍是江戶時代的存量武器,兩者之間的落差,正是一八六四年這批志士用性命換來的教訓。
kitsEn: The Gatling gun on this card had only just emerged from the experimental stage in 1864. Richard Jordan Gatling completed his design and took out his patent in 1860, driving six barrels round by a hand crank, every round being fired down a single central axis so that the recoil was spread over six separate discharges, giving a rate of fire far above that of any contemporary single-barrel gun; it was first put to work in small numbers in the American Civil War from 1862, Britain and France only afterwards began to try it out, and not a single East Asian country had taken delivery of one. What the Tengu Party actually carried belonged to a completely different age: almost exclusively matchlock muskets of a type out of production since the eighteenth century, such as the old Japanese Kunitomo pieces, with spears and swords for close work. Whether a few foreign weapons reached them by way of smuggling through Nagasaki is reported differently in the sources, but what can be established is that their main armament was still the long-discontinued matchlock, and that they had it in limited quantity. By contrast the Choshu domain soldiers had already been converted to percussion rifles and equipped with artillery, and the shogunate's expedition column brought the mortars and guns of Kishu. The Gatling's place in this campaign is precisely the turn of the era it marks: the age of the multi-barrel machine gun, which displaced the old gun with light weight and high rate of fire, was arriving, while the Tengu Party's hands were still full of the stock weapons of the Edo period, and the gulf between the two is the lesson that the patriots of 1864 bought with their lives.
tactics: 天狗黨的戰術是山區游擊而非會戰:小隊分散,多在夜間行軍,利用大周防的峽谷、村落與山林遮蔽,切斷藩兵的通信與糧道,伏擊落單的巡邏隊與徵糧小組,以火繩銃在近距離射擊,得手即散,從不與藩兵正面硬拼;其弱點也正在這裡——沒有攻城器械、沒有後備、糧食全靠鄉村供應,久拖必然崩潰。柳井三山一役是它唯一一次被迫在狹地作戰,結果是被合圍。藩軍的戰術則完全是另一套:以數個縱隊分進合擊,先由洋銃隊在通路兩側高地建立射擊線,再以砲封住谷口,兩翼同時夾擊,截斷退路,圍攻數日,直至黨徒潰散或被俘;同一時間內,長州藩把主力放在與幕府的交涉上,只以小股兵力追擊天狗黨。幕府第一次征討長州則套用近代圍城戰的邏輯:三路大軍分別由美濃、紀伊、豐前方向會師,以砲兵封鎖萩城再逐步推進,卻因各路互不統一指揮、補給線過長而在萩城前僵持,最後以講和收場。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the Tengu Party were guerrilla action in the hills rather than set-piece battle. Small bands dispersed, marching mostly by night, using the gorges, villages and woods of Osuo for cover, cutting the domain soldiers' communications and supply line, ambushing isolated patrols and foraging parties, shooting at close range with matchlocks and scattering as soon as the blow was struck, never standing up to the domain troops in a straight fight; their weakness lay in exactly that, in having no siege equipment, no reserves and food wholly dependent on the villages, with certain collapse if the campaign dragged on. The action at Miyama in Ichinomiya was the one time they were forced to fight in confined ground, and the result was encirclement. The domain's tactics were the opposite: several columns advancing to converge, percussion rifle teams first establishing a line of fire on the heights flanking the road, guns then sealing the mouth of the valley, both wings closing at once to cut off the retreat and pressing the attack for several days until the party broke up or was captured; over the same period Choshu put its main strength into the negotiations with the shogunate and sent only small bodies of men after the Tengu Party. The shogunate's First Choshu Expedition followed the logic of modern siege warfare: three field armies converging from Mino, Kishu and Buzen, artillery locking down Hagi Castle before the infantry advanced by degrees, but the columns would not act in concert, the supply lines stretched too far, and the stalemate before Hagi Castle ended in a negotiated peace.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。天狗黨起事時三十餘人,至大周防一帶增至百餘至三百人上下,常見說法是二百人左右;一八六四年元治元年四月二十八日(三山決戰)之後,生還者約三十人。第一次征討長州於一八六四年夏出動,幕府軍總兵力約一萬二千人,另有說法接近一萬五千,長州藩軍約四千人;同年秋以講和告終,幕府未攻下萩城。第二次征討長州時(一八六六年),幕府軍增至約三萬五千人,長州藩軍約一萬五千人,仍未能取勝。相關的時間點:一八六三年十二月萩之亂,先祓徒眾殺死幕府方郡司楫取道明與宮長惠美;一八六四年元治元年二月十七日天狗黨在萩起事,同年四月二十八日三山決戰;高杉晉作生於一八三九年,至一八六八年遇襲身亡時年二十九;加特林機槍一八六〇年問世,一八六二年始用於實戰,日本購置此類機關砲遲至一八七〇年代,並在西南戰爭中試用。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The Tengu Party numbered a little over thirty men at the outset and grew in the Osuo area to somewhere between a hundred and three hundred, the figure most often given being about two hundred; after the action at Miyama on the twenty-eighth day of the fourth month of Genji 1, in 1864, only about thirty were left alive. The First Choshu Expedition was launched in the summer of 1864, the shogunate's total force being about twelve thousand men, with one account putting it nearer fifteen thousand, against some four thousand for Choshu; it ended in an autumn peace, and Hagi Castle was never taken. At the Second Choshu Expedition of 1866 the shogunate's troops were raised to about thirty-five thousand against roughly fifteen thousand for the domain, and still failed to win. The related dates are these: in December 1863 the Senpuku men killed the shogunate officials Kaidori Michiaki and Miyanaga Keimi at Hagi; on the seventeenth day of the second month of Genji 1, 1864, the Tengu Party rose at Hagi, and on the twenty-eighth day of the fourth month of the same year the action at Miyama was fought; Takasugi Shintaro was born in 1839 and was killed by attack in 1868 at the age of twenty-nine; the Gatling gun appeared in 1860 and was first used in earnest in 1862; and Japan did not acquire weapons of the machine-gun type until the 1870s, when they were tried out in the Seinan War.
cause: 打起來的原因有四層。最外一層是開港以後尊王攘夷的風潮,以及幕府在對外通商上受制於外國船隻與通商口岸的壓力:九州近海與長崎港的接舷衝突、列強對日本內政的干預,都令國內的旗幟爭奪更加激烈。第二層是一八六三年十二月萩之亂:先祓的浪人闖入萩城下的町,殺死幕府方的郡司楫取道明與宮長惠美,把尊王攘夷從口號變成流血,幕府隨即以此為口實,籌劃第一次征討長州。第三層是長州藩自身的內部矛盾:藩政財政吃緊,藩內分為對幕府講和與對內舉兵兩派,高杉等受吉田松陰學說影響的青年在藩中無路可走,遂在藩外集結。第四層是天狗黨自己的政治算盤:他們相信只要以自己的性命製造一場足以牽動幕府兵力的大規模騷亂,就能逼幕府把全部注意力壓在長州,讓藩內的尊王派或倒幕派順勢得到機會;而長州藩的算盤正好相反——寧可自己動手鎮壓,也不肯讓幕府的兵進來,因為一旦徵討軍攻破萩城,藩的自主權也會一併失去。三方目標因此互相牴觸,衝突無可避免。
causeEn: There were four layers of cause. The outermost was the tide of sonno-joi after the opening of the ports and the pressure of the shogunate's dependence on foreign trade: incidents involving foreign ships off Kyushu and in the harbour of Nagasaki, and foreign interference in Japanese internal affairs, all sharpened the struggle over the banner at home. The second was the disturbance at Hagi in December 1863, when ronin of the Senpuku band entered the town below Hagi Castle and killed the shogunate officials Kaidori Michiaki and Miyanaga Keimi, turning sonno-joi from a slogan into blood, whereupon the shogunate used the killings as its pretext and began to plan the First Choshu Expedition. The third was the internal contradiction of the Choshu domain itself: exhausted finances, a domain split between those who would make peace with the shogunate and those who would rise against it, and young men such as Takasugi, steeped in the teaching of Yoshida Shoin, who had no road open to them inside the domain and so gathered outside it. The fourth was the Tengu Party's own political calculation: they believed that if they spent their own lives to raise a disturbance large enough to pull the shogunate's forces after them, the shogunate's whole attention would be pinned on Choshu and the sonno or anti-shogunate party inside the domain would get its opening. Choshu's calculation was the mirror image of this: it would rather suppress them with its own soldiers than let the shogunate's army in, because once the expedition took Hagi Castle the domain's own autonomy would go with it. The three aims were therefore in collision, and the clash was unavoidable.
impact: 後果分即時與長遠兩層。即時一層是幕府第一次征討長州無功而還:三路大軍攻不下萩城,最後靠益田孝、村田實藏一方的斡旋才以講和收場,幕府花費大量兵員與糧秣卻未達目的,威信與財政同時受損;這也直接導致一八六六年第二次征討,幕府以三萬五千人仍不能取勝,反而把藩的離心與倒幕派的力量推了出來。長遠一層在天狗黨自身:殘黨(如高杉晉作、內田良平)眼看同藩先鋒竟站在幕府軍一側鎮壓自己,「藩內改良無望」的判斷由此確立;高杉一八六五年回萩獲赦入藩,一八六六年組織奇兵隊,一八六七年促成薩長同盟,一八六八年入新政府核心,同年四月在京都遇襲身亡;他早年曾致書在京都的坂本龍馬勸其入長州,龍馬其後於一八六七年遇害。內田良平在土佐龍潛浦事件後被捕,後獲赦免,一八六九年在京都創建照國神社,而高杉同年也在萩的松下村塾舊地建濟生院以奉祀松陰。裝備層面的教訓同樣清楚:以火繩銃對抗洋銃與大砲、以浪人游擊對抗編制完善的大軍,勝算極低,日本此後的軍隊改革正是朝著全換洋裝、常設編制與新式機關砲的方向走,明治初年才購得加特林機槍一類的兵器,並在西南戰爭中試用。明治以後,天狗黨被敘述為「志士」的典型,高杉晉作被塑造成維新英雄;與此同時,「藩主為保王權而鎮壓旗下志士」也成為近代日本政治記憶裡最尖銳的批評之一。
impactEn: The consequences ran in two layers, immediate and long-term. Immediately, the shogunate's First Choshu Expedition achieved nothing: three field armies could not take Hagi Castle, and the matter was closed by a peace negotiated with the help of men such as Masuda Takashi and Murata Juzo, the shogunate having spent men and provisions for no gain and losing both prestige and credit. That in turn led straight to the Second Choshu Expedition of 1866, in which thirty-five thousand men again failed to win and instead pushed the domains towards independence and strengthened the anti-shogunate party. In the longer term the effect fell on the Tengu Party itself: the survivors, Takasugi Shintaro and Uchida Ryohei among them, watched their own domain's vanguard stand on the shogunate's side to destroy them, and the judgement that reform from within the domain was hopeless was thereby settled. Takasugi returned to Hagi in 1865, was pardoned and entered the domain's service, organised his kihei-tai in 1866, brought about the Satsuma-Choshu alliance in 1867 and entered the core of the new government in 1868, only to be attacked and killed in Kyoto that April; he had earlier written to Sakamoto Ryoma in Kyoto urging him to come to Choshu, and Ryoma was himself killed in 1867. Uchida Ryohei was arrested after the Ryusen'yo affair in Tosa, was later pardoned, and founded the Shokoku Shrine in Kyoto in 1869, while in the same year Takasugi built the Seishoin at the site of the Matsushita Village School in Hagi to enshrine Shoin. The lesson in equipment was equally plain: matchlocks against percussion rifles and artillery, and irregulars against an army with proper organisation, is a very poor proposition, and Japanese military reform after that moved towards full Western equipment, a standing army and the new machine guns; it was only in the early Meiji years that Japan bought weapons of the Gatling type and tried them out in the Seinan War. After the Meiji Restoration the Tengu Party was written up as the model of the shishi, and Takasugi Shintaro was cast as a hero of the Restoration; at the same time, the picture of a lord crushing the patriots of his own domain in order to preserve royal authority became one of the sharpest criticisms in modern Japanese political memory.
result: 結果是天狗黨覆滅、幕府勉強得逞。元治元年四月二十八日(西曆一八六四年六月),殘存百餘人的黨徒在柳井三山被長州藩軍包圍,激戰後大部戰死,被俘者多遭處決,生還者不過三十人左右,四散逃亡,少數輾轉到達薩摩等地,再無成軍可能。幕府以為天狗黨事件提供了討平長州的契機,卻在第一次征討中攻不下萩城,最後只能以講和收場;長州藩既不肯交出天狗黨,又不敢任其坐大,遂以自兵鎮壓換取同幕府的暫時相安,藩內尊王派因此受挫,倒幕派則在挫折中得勢。結果的另一面是幕府的空洞勝利:它證明了關東的中央權力連一個外藩都無法正面壓倒,所謂「征討成功」只維持到一八六六年,第二次征討同樣無功而返,藩的獨立性與朝覲體制的崩解加速,一八六七年的薩長同盟與一八六八年的戊辰戰爭隨之而來,天狗黨用血肉開啟的這條路,最終通向明治維新。
resultEn: The result was the destruction of the Tengu Party and a qualified success for the shogunate. On the twenty-eighth day of the fourth month of Genji 1, in June 1864 by the Western calendar, the remaining hundred or so men of the party were encircled by the Choshu domain troops at Miyama in Ichinomiya; after hard fighting most were killed, those captured were for the most part executed, and only about thirty survived to scatter, of whom a few eventually made their way to Satsuma, and no military body survived. The shogunate had expected the Tengu Party affair to give it its chance to finish off Choshu, but the First Choshu Expedition could not take Hagi Castle and the matter had to be closed with a negotiated peace. Choshu would neither hand over the Tengu Party nor allow it to grow, and so it bought a temporary modus vivendi with the shogunate by putting the party down with its own soldiers; the sonno party inside the domain was checked, and the anti-shogunate party grew stronger out of the disappointment. The other face of the result was the shogunate's hollow victory. It had proved that the central power in the east could not bring even one outer domain to terms, and the so-called successful expedition held for nothing beyond 1866, when a second expedition failed in the same way. The independence of the domains and the disintegration of the audience system quickened, and with them the Satsuma-Choshu alliance of 1867 and the Boshin War of 1868. The road that the Tengu Party opened with its blood led at last to the Meiji Restoration.
